title: OSVČ Forms Helper input
description: Answer a few questions about your business year and you get every row of the tax return (daňové přiznání), the ČSSZ přehled and the VZP přehled filled in and explained. Have these ready: how much your business earned, how you count expenses, and how much you paid to ČSSZ and VZP during the year (your bank statements, ePortál ČSSZ or Moje VZP show it). Each field below says where to find the number. We never ask for your name, rodné číslo or other personal details.

taxYear.title: 1. Which year are you filing for?
taxYear.description: The year you earned the money. For income earned in 2025 you file in spring 2026.

activityType.title: 2. Is your business your main job? (hlavní / vedlejší činnost)
activityType.description: Choose 'side activity' only if for the whole year you also had another status, for example: you were employed, a student under 26, received a pension, were on maternity or parental leave, or cared for a dependent person. Otherwise choose 'main activity'. Not sure? Check what you ticked on last year's ČSSZ přehled (row 13).
enumTitles: Main activity: the business is my main job (hlavní činnost)
Side activity: I was also employed, studying, retired or on parental leave (vedlejší činnost)

income.title: 3. How much did your business earn in the year? (příjmy)
income.description: All the money your customers actually paid you for your business during the year, before subtracting any costs or taxes. Add up the paid invoices in your invoicing app or the incoming payments on your bank statements. If you are a VAT payer (plátce DPH), use the amounts without VAT.

expenseMode.title: 4. How do you count your business costs? (výdaje)
expenseMode.description: Most freelancers use the fixed percentage: you don't need receipts, a set share of your income counts as your costs. Choose real costs only if you keep records of all business costs (daňová evidence) and they are higher than the percentage.
enumTitles: A fixed percentage of my income, no receipts needed (paušální výdaje)
My real costs from receipts and records (skutečné výdaje)

flatRatePercent.title: 5. Which percentage applies to you? (only for the fixed percentage)
flatRatePercent.description: It depends on your trade licence. Look it up in the trade register (výpis z živnostenského rejstříku): a craft trade (řemeslná živnost) is 80 %, any other trade licence (volná, vázaná or koncesovaná živnost) is 60 %. Not sure and you have a trade licence? It is most likely 60 %. Each percentage has a maximum: 1 600 000 / 1 200 000 / 800 000 / 600 000 Kč of costs.
enumTitles: 80 % – craft trades (e.g. plumber, electrician, hairdresser) and farming
60 % – all other trade licences (e.g. IT services, consulting, sales, marketing)
40 % – work without a trade licence: royalties (autorské honoráře) and professions like doctor, lawyer, architect
30 % – renting out property that belongs to the business

actualExpenses.title: 6. Your real business costs (only for real costs)
actualExpenses.description: Fill in only if you chose 'my real costs' in step 4: the total of all your business costs for the year from your records (daňová evidence). Leave empty otherwise.

childrenCount.title: 7. How many children do you claim the child tax benefit for?
childrenCount.description: Children who lived with you all year and whom you support: under 18, or up to 26 if still studying. Only one parent can claim a child, so if your partner already claims them (e.g. through their employer), enter 0. No children: leave 0.

socialAdvancesPaid.title: 8. How much did you pay to ČSSZ (social security) for the year?
socialAdvancesPaid.description: Add up all the monthly payments to your local social security office (OSSZ) for the months of the year. With a main activity in 2025 it was at least 4 759 Kč a month (57 108 Kč for the whole year). You find it in your bank statements or in ePortál ČSSZ. Don't include any extra payment you made for the previous year (doplatek). Paid nothing (e.g. small side activity)? Leave 0.

healthAdvancesPaid.title: 9. How much did you pay to VZP (health insurance) for the year?
healthAdvancesPaid.description: Add up all the monthly payments to VZP for the months of the year, including the December payment made by 8 January. With a main activity in 2025 it was at least 3 143 Kč a month (37 716 Kč for the whole year). You find it in Moje VZP or in your bank statements. Don't include any extra payment for the previous year (doplatek). Paid nothing? Leave 0.

taxAdvancesPaid.title: 10. Did you pay income tax in advance? (zálohy na daň)
taxAdvancesPaid.description: Almost every freelancer leaves this at 0. Advance tax payments only apply if your previous year's income tax was over 30 000 Kč and the tax office expected you to pay part of it during the year. If you did, enter the total you paid.

notes.title: 11. Anything you want explained? (optional)
notes.description: Ask in your own words, e.g. 'Why is my health insurance higher than I expected?' or 'I started my business in March, does that change anything?'. Also mention anything unusual about your year and the tool will tell you if it can't handle it. The answer only explains, it never changes the numbers. Don't write your name, rodné číslo or other personal details.

language.title: 12. Language of the explanations
language.description: The official Czech row names from the forms are always shown too, so you can match them on the official websites.
